title: useScore Hook
description:
Implement a `useScore` hook that returns `{ score, add, subtract, reset }`. The score never goes below zero — `subtract` clamps at `0`. `reset` returns to the `initial` value.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { score, add, subtract, reset } = useScore(0);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: forgetting to clamp on subtract — writing setScore(s => s - amount) without Math.max(0, ...) allows the score to go negative.
